about_the_game:
These are high-quality soundtrack albums from The Nick in MP3 and FLAC formats, featuring BONUS, including 3 unique tracks by French composer Christophe Pereuil.

If you enjoyed the game and its music, it's recommended to purchase the soundtrack for offline listening anytime! It's best experienced after completing the game, as some tracks may contain story spoilers.
detailed_description:
Buy today is support

This product will be updated regularly as new soundtrack albums are released with new chapters and updates. Buying this now will give you access to the new content for free. As new chapters are released, the price of the soundtrack will go up, so think hard about buying it now if you've fallen in love with it!
